name: @vit129/agy-plugin-cc
description: Claude Code plugin installer and updater for the Antigravity agy companion.

scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm test && npm pack --dry-run
scripts.check: node --check plugins/agy/scripts/agy-companion.mjs && for f in plugins/agy/scripts/features/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node --check plugins/agy/scripts/lib/git-update-check.mjs && node --check plugins/agy/scripts/session-lifecycle-hook.mjs && node --check scripts/set-release-version.mjs && node scripts/check-version.mjs && for f in apps/agent-usage/*.mjs apps/agent-usage/ui/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
